title: A model response to an unequal split
hook: Two stated cases: explore a payoff-based proxy rather than a brain measurement.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a payoff-based proxy rather than a brain measurement affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Utility, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a payoff-based proxy rather than a brain measurement in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy utility equals own payoff 2 minus weight 0.5 times any shortfall below other payoff 8. What is utility?
